把游戏发给虚拟手柄的震动／灯光交回当前所选实体手柄。Xbox 主要提供震动，Du: Forward game rumble and lighting from the virtual gamepad to the selected physical controller. Xbox mainly provides rumble; DualShock 4 can also provide lighting. Support depends on the physical interface.
选择虚拟 Xbox／DualShock 4 输出后，游戏反馈回传才会运行。: Choose virtual Xbox or DualShock 4 output to forward game feedback.
等待新的游戏反馈: Waiting for a new game feedback command
录入、停止、断线和切换时释放震动，恢复后等待新的游戏命令。停止灯光回传时取消待发: Recording, stopping, disconnecting and switching release rumble. Resuming waits for a new game command. Stopping lighting cancels pending colors and leaves the device at its last color.
沿用 FlexInput 原生手势：单指移动、双指滚动、单指轻点左键、双指轻点右: Uses native FlexInput gestures: one-finger pointing, two-finger scrolling, one-finger tap for left click, two-finger tap for right click, and click-drag. With two pads, the left scrolls and the right points; clicking both produces a middle click.
保存后应用。启用或切换时手指已在触摸板上，会等待全部抬起再开始，避免误点击。动作: Save to apply. Fingers already held when enabling or switching must lift before gestures start, preventing accidental clicks. Touchpad button actions in the action list still run.
当前接口已报告触摸板，预览保留原始触点。: This interface reports a touchpad. The preview shows raw contacts.
当前接口未报告触摸板。可以先保存设置，连接支持触摸坐标的接口后使用。: This interface does not report a touchpad. Save the settings now and use them after connecting an interface with touch coordinates.
配置触摸板鼠标、原生手势与点按动作。: Configure touchpad mouse, native gestures and click actions.
震动强度必须在 0–2 之间: Rumble strength must be between 0 and 2
触摸板速度必须在 0.1–5 之间: Touchpad speed must be between 0.1 and 5
